name: The Peasants' Crown
about: Bread riots in a great lord's town turn into a rising of the poor, led by a hedge-priest in a crown of straw. Feed them, crush them or make a deal, and see which lords start using the poor as a weapon.
title: The Peasants' Crown

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: The price of bread in {town} doubles in a month. A crowd breaks down the doors of {lord}'s grain store, and {lord}'s men break up the crowd.

court.text: {lord} of {lord.house}: "The mob in {town} attacked my stores, Your Grace. I want your leave to hang every one of them."

options.label: Open the royal granaries to {town} (200 gold)
options.result: The King's grain reaches {town}. The same crowd that broke into the stores now queues quietly for bread.

options.label: Let {lord} hang the ringleaders
options.hint: {lord.houseName} +10 · the poor won't forget the gallows
options.result: Seven are hanged in the square at {town}. That night, someone paints a crown on the gallows.

options.label: Set the price of bread by royal order
options.result: The King sets the price of bread in {town}. The merchants hide their flour.

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: A hedge-priest wearing a crown of straw preaches in the fields outside {town}. No lords, no tithes, and every man keeps his own bread. Thousands come to hear him, and they bring their scythes.

court.text: {opportunist} of {opportunist.house}: "The poor of {town} have their own king now, Your Grace. If you don't deal with it, someone will use them."

options.label: Hear the straw king out at Kingsmere (300 gold)
options.hint: the poor pay a lower tithe · {lord.houseName} −20
options.result: The straw king comes to Kingsmere under the King's protection, and goes home with a charter for {town}.

options.label: Send knights to break them up
options.result: Knights ride into the crowd outside {town}. They break it up and fill a ditch with the dead.

beats.speaker: opportunist
beats.text: {opportunist} backs the straw king, so the poor of the realm march on Kingsmere under {opportunist.house}'s banner. They've been promised bread and no tithes.

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: With food in their bellies, the people of {town} go back to work. Nobody ever weaves the straw crown.

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: The charter of {town} is read out in every square in the realm. The poor go home with their rights in writing, and the straw king hangs his crown over a sept door.

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: The rising is crushed. The poor go back to the fields, but they keep singing about the straw king in secret, and those songs last longest.
